text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"*yawn*... Huh, Ai-chan? 
You're up early, aren't you? It's only 5 
AM..."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Well, yesterday was... you know. 
I couldn't get around to a lot of the 
things I had planned."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...I understand. The reason why 
Sky-san... and Pandora-san took us out. 
I think I get what they were trying to 
do."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Even so—I don't think I need that right 
now. 
Right now, I want to move forward. I just 
want to keep my eyes fixed ahead."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"If I stop today, I won't be able to win 
tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, I'm off to train! 
See you later, Kiseki-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Ah, yeah. See you—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"(...She's already ahead of me, and yet 
she's pushing herself even harder than I 
am...)"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"............ Yeah, there's no way I can 
just sit around resting either. 
Alright. I'm gonna—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"*pant*, *pant*... Whew. 
Hm? Who's that over there...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Toryaaa~!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Bright is out training today, too. 
...She really does have a great run, 
though.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(It's not about overwhelming her opponents 
with raw acceleration. It's about 
enduring, biding her time, and seizing the 
win at the very end.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Bright! 
If it's alright with you—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind running a lap together with 
me?

text_block_list.name: Bright & Eye
text_block_list.text: Teyaaa~! Haaaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(...So this is how Bright runs! It's not 
just a matter of distance aptitude—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(There's real depth to her stride. All the 
effort she's accumulated, all the 
experience she's built up... It shines 
through in every single step...!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... Bright! 
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Not at all~. Thank you for providing such 
a meaningful time as well~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Even though you aren't a stayer, Ai, you 
went out of your way to match my 
distance... You must be quite exhausted, 
no?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not at all! Sure, it was a distance 
I'm not used to, but... I'm really glad we 
did it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I got to experience your strength 
firsthand, after all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
What do you say? If you're up for more 
matching runs after this, I'd love to join 
you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I would love to, but... a little bit 
of fatigue has caught up with me, so I 
think I shall call it a day~.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah... I-Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. I am a rather leisurely sort, you 
see~. I shall take it easy and do my best 
at my own pace~.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I understand. Thanks for the training 
session! Let's do it again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Phew, phew, pheew... Huh? 
...Wait, Bright?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(She's watching the girls training... 
watching us? But why? Gathering intel, 
maybe?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(...No. ...That's not it. I recognize that 
look. That's not it at all, that's—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(—That's the look of someone holding back 
because of their condition, when deep 
down, all they want to do is run.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello, Ai~. My apologies~. Was I 
disturbing your training~?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all, really! It's just, I... 
um—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's so frustrating... isn't it? When your 
body won't keep up with your heart. That 
happens to me a lot, too... So—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Thank you very much for your 
concern.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
However, I truly am quite fine~. The 
frustration, the impatience, the 
exasperation... it is all completely fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
For the primary focus of my efforts is not 
merely the 'now.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The future of the Mejiro. —The destination 
waiting far, far down this road. I believe 
the present exists solely so that I may 
reach that place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is why this is perfectly fine. I will 
not push myself too hard. For now, I shall 
simply gaze leisurely upon the passing of 
the seasons.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: As I await the return of spring.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Waiting is something of a specialty of 
mine~. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I... see... That's amazing. You have 
such an incredible sense of purpose.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So that's why... Ah, I get it. 
Bright is—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Even when she's resting, she's definitely 
moving forward. Step by step, toward the 
place she wants to reach.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Bright. I think I'm going to start 
valuing rest a lot more, too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Because I want to beat you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nothing's biting, huh.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Not a bite.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. So what brought this on all of a 
sudden? Asking me to teach you the secret 
to taking it easy and all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I learned it from Bright. That to win 
races, time like this is necessary, too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So I wanted to ask you, since taking it 
easy is Sky-san's specialty! I'd love some 
pointers!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Right. I feel like I'm barely being 
complimented here, but... Hmm. So you 
realized it's good to pause every once in 
a while?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because the 'now' matters, too! 
—In order to win next time!
